name: Chanzhi
quote: The flowers paint the springs a jade-like green, and the birds' plumage is as gilded needles.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning! Your hair looks messy, Professor. Stay still! I'll fix it for you.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Hello! Oh, wait a minute. I'm still tidying your workplace for you. It will be done in a minute!

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Professor, you're finally here! Hurry up, the supermarket's flash sale is about to end! Come on, follow me!

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Whew, I can finally take a break. My eyes are tired.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: One stitch, two stitches, three stitches... Hehe, that's how you embroider a Qinggeng bird of happiness!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Professor! You forgot your personal items in the control room again. You're welcome! I'll always be sure to remind you if that happens again!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor, did you fall asleep again? Oh, the files are scattered all over the place... I'll clean them up.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Professor! Miss Riko is hosting a flea market in the Oasis on a vacant lot! Let's go check it out!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hmm? Do you want my handkerchief? I embroidered the pattern all by myself! It's cute, right? Hehe!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: It's a pain for me to watch the other Dolls when they struggle with their work. I wish I could do the work for them.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Oh, right! Please tap on this link for me! Then I'll be able to buy this set of three items with only 1 DGC!

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Leave it to me, I will finish the job perfectly!

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I'm Chanzhi, a master embroiderer. I'm really good with my needles, I tell you!

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: An inspiration just hit me!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I just made a new outfit. What do you think?

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I'm definitely going to host my solo exhibition someday. Please look forward to it!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: I'm good at fighting too.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Leave it to me!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: I'll turn you all into stuffed animals!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Guys! Are you all right?

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: It's not a waste of my threads as long as we won.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: All my efforts for nothing...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
A-Are you really going to choose me?
... I don't think there's anything particularly attractive about me other than that I'm good at saving money, so I'm a little... surprised, that Professor likes me. —Erm, well, let's call it a win-win for us!
Gosh, even if this is all a lie I've already entrusted my life to you! Promise that you'll never run away from me! Liars will have to swallow a thousand embroidery needles!

voices.label: New Year
voices.text:
Happy new year!
It's been another year in Magrasea. This place is flourishing all thanks to you, Professor.
I'll sew a bright red flower on your lab coat to thank you! Hehe!

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Professor, erm... Today is Valentine's Day, right? I just bought some chocolates since they were on sale... Here you go.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text:
Ta-da, I created this piece for today! It's called The New Magpie Bridge Reunion.
A lost Doll meets a human who was looking for her on a magpie bridge. How do you like it? It looks super lively, right?
Hmm? Why is that human in a lab coat? Well, um, I didn't notice that before you pointed it out...

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Boo! Did I scare you? Ahahahaha! Hand in all your treats if you don't want to be tricked! As many as possible!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: A Christmas Sale!? Even though I already splurged last month, the paycheck for December is here! What should I do? ... Ugh, I really want that automatic washing machine! These dastardly, wicked consumer traps!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text:
Happy birthday, professor! Today is a very important day for you.
Here you go, it's a handkerchief sewn with golden threads. Ah, yes. I've embroidered a chibi version of you on it too.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud.

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Professor, did you know that the technique of embroidery originated in the East since ancient times, and that it had almost gone extinct at one point? That's why Cyber Media developed Embroidery Maker type Dolls like me to pass down this technique! Hence I will never sell any work I've created, no matter who's trying to buy it, or how much money they offer!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
It is my mission to protect this ancient cultural heritage with utmost care. For that, I will do my best at my job!
Professor, I'm with you here. If you ever feel like you're shouldering too much responsibility, you can always rely on me! I'll sort it all out for you! You can entrust any task to me as long as it's within my ability!

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
I got scammed and lost another 10k DGC today! Why do I always fall for such blatant lies...
When I look at their kind smile and the lucrative conditions they offer, I always lose my judgment... Professor, please keep an eye on me from now on!

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
By the way, are you really okay wearing such thin clothes all year? I think you're going to catch a cold if you don't take care of yourself better.
—Woah! Now you're having a runny nose! Okay, I've decided. Be sure to drop by a few days later, I'll have something for you!
...What is it, you ask? That's a secret, of course! It would be no fun to tell you right away!

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Oh, you're here, Professor! I've finished organizing your combat materials. Is there anything else I can help you with?
... The thing I mentioned last time? That's... Yeah, I've finished it, but... Professor, please turn around first...
—How is it? Does it feel warm?
It's nothing expensive, since a scarf won't cost much money... Oh, I'm giving you this work of mine for free. You don't need to pay me for that.

career:
The Embroidery Maker Doll (CM-EM), is an "Intangible Cultural Heritage" (ICH) model created by Cyber Media in collaboration with IESCO. As the tangible heirs to ICH, these Dolls are placed on a special list. Members of all officially registered international organizations are not allowed to harm these Dolls under any circumstances except self-defense or risk being prosecuted under the Non-Material Cultural Heritage Protection Regulations enforced by IESCO.

Project Neural Cloud selected at least one Doll from all "Intangible Cultural Heritage" models, and Chanzhi was selected to represent the CM-EMs.
infoStories:
Chanzhi's name was not given to her by Cyber Media, but rather from the master embroiderers who woke her. Her name is derived from a cloud brocade pattern that features flowers and vines intertwining to form a whole pattern. The meaning imbued in the name is "continuous and unbroken, life grows endlessly".

Chanzhi adores this name as much as those who gave it to her. She believes that embroiderers should not just pass on techniques, but also the contributions of the artisans in the field.

Therefore, when introducing embroidery to the public or teaching, she always takes the time to elaborate on each stitch, explaining who created it, whom she learned it from, and their comings and goings.

These little insights have little tangible impact on teaching efficacy, more often rousing a grumble from the crowd, but it is just Chanzhi's habit.

Besides embroidery, Chanzhi also has a special fondness for the dialect of the region where she awoke. She greatly admires its soft and light sound. However, she did not possess any language learning software and could only learn over time, just as a human would. Unfortunately, she was too set in her own speech patterns, and she had not yet mastered the necessary vocal skills by the time she left. Her inability to pick up the dialect was a regret that lingered in her mind.

Still, this reflected the difference between Chanzhi and others of her model. Through embroidery, Chanzhi fell in love with this land and would go on to learn many things outside of her field. This desire to learn changed her. Not only did it improve her needlework, but it also made her more human-like.

Embodying both form and spirit, in the field of embroidery, Chanzhi stands above all others.

Perhaps due to the length of time she spent studying with the older generation of master embroiderers, Chanzhi not only learned their techniques, but also some other oddities.

"Today, I wish to talk to everyone about telecommunications fraud. As we all know, science and technology are developing quickly, but that means deception techniques are also evolving apace. In our country, many middle-aged and elderly people are facing..."

In a special column from the 2055 edition of Demotic Daily, a young girl's face stands out from the many blurred-out photos of elderly victims.

Of course, Chanzhi's skills are not limited to embroidery. Her deft hands are also good at sewing clothes. Although the two crafts differ, the needlework for both is generally the same.

During breaks, Chanzhi and the masters would often move wooden benches to the door of the institute. She would bask in the sun, rolling up yarn, while listening to them go on and on about stories from the past.

Although Chanzhi has no use for the clothes she sews, most of them being given to the masters or their younger relatives, she never bores of the pastime. It allows her to embroider the more "interesting" ideas that spring to mind over the course of her day. To Chanzhi, it's a special sort of entertainment.

It is a rare person who can connect these outlandish decorations, which look akin to a child's scribbling, to Chanzhi. After all, in the public's consciousness, Chanzhi's creations are gorgeous works of art, rich in everlasting meaning.

After the Wipe-off Incident, Chanzhi did not display any dissatisfaction with being confined to Magrasea. On the contrary, she breathed a sigh of relief, ready to vacation in the Cloud.

Although the "Intangible Cultural Heritage" series of Dolls are special, it is possible to request their services through particular channels. Before participating in Project Neural Cloud, Cyber Media had assigned Chanzhi to a special crafting studio directed at high-end customers. For her work, Chanzhi was fairly compensated and while it did give her a sense of accomplishment, it was nevertheless natural for a creator to feel stifled within such constraints.

After settling into the Oasis, Chanzhi quickly took over the design work for the Dolls' clothing. Not only did she have a lot of time to express her creativity, but she could also see everyone wear and appreciate her works. This was something that gave Chanzhi a deep sense of pride.
oathDesc: Imbue your feelings into every stitch.

projections.name: Little Embroiderer
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Stitches neat, layered, long and short; needles prick gauze inlaid with gold. Stitching mountains, rivers, lands unseen; threading needle through realms between.

projections.name: Embroidered Demure
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"On embroidered gown of delicate thread, borne on cotton cloud our fairy treads."

skinList.name: Bejeweled Coral
skinList.desc:
[Ocean Dancer Series]
"I can take this shell and this crab with me if no one else is claiming them, right?"—Or so the seagulls thought, too.

skinList.name: Wishing Projection
skinList.desc:
Warming fireworks fill the silent night, and as the embers fall, they transform into countless candleflames. This is the most beautiful scene that the Dolls left behind on a Qixi summer night.
"I hope this fan keeps you company like a memento. After all, the two-sided embroidery on it could be said to be a joint effort between us!"

skinList.name: Bearer of Divine Tidings
skinList.desc:
Mythical Journey—Within a mysterious domain, the Dolls lose themselves in ancient myths, searching for the lingering echoes of legendary heroes.
Within the sacred realm of the Jade Pond, upon the snowy peak of Mt. Kunlun, the girl sits alone upon a celestial tree in the company of an azure luan as she listens to the divine bird's tidings.
"To deftly discern the voices of countless people with the finesse of a needle passing through cloth, and then convey them to the objects of their affections—that is how the loveliest of landscapes is woven."
